From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@carebridge.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@carebridge.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Sponsor confirmation + SLA exception path

Hi Marta / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick follow-up and proposed next steps based on the discovery:

Key takeaways
- Use case: auto-triage and summary for inbound clinical messages (pilot scope: 2k messages/day)
- Data residency: US-only for PHI subset; CareBridge needs audit logs and limited retention window
- Security: procurement will request SOC 2 evidence and encryption details
- Stakeholders: Tom is the technical lead; you mentioned there’s an economic sponsor in finance but we didn’t get a name in the call

Questions / asks for this week
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer (name and title) so we can loop them into pricing conversations?
2) Please share the procurement contact and any standard PO/contract docs (we can accept a procurement email or shared folder).
3) Do you require an SLA better than our standard 99.9% (you mentioned 99.99% for certain customers)? If so, please confirm target SLA and whether penalties/credits are required.

Operational note: if CareBridge needs an elevated SLA or contract changes we’ll route an internal exception (discount/SLA waiver) for approval. To keep timelines tight, please confirm econ sponsor and procurement contact by EOD Fri — we’d like legal + procurement on the same thread.

Next steps (proposed)
- You confirm econ sponsor + procurement contact (CareBridge) — Marta/Tom
- We provide an initial commercial outline (ballpark pricing + pilot discount options) — Redwood (Neha)
- If special SLA/terms required, we’ll submit an internal exception for Ben’s approval and loop Legal

I attached a short call summary for your notes (discovery-notes-carebridge.pdf).

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: discovery-notes-carebridge.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

Thanks, Irene — great recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Economic sponsor: Maria Alvarez, CFO (maria.alvarez@carebridge.ai) — she signs off on pilot budget for integrations
- Technical sponsor: Tom Nguyen (cc’d) — will own evaluation and integration testing
- Procurement: procurement@carebridge.ai (copied) handles PO and contract intake; they’ve asked for SOC 2 Type II and an org data-retention summary
- SLA: for a subset of customers (enterprise payer integrations) we typically require 99.99% and financial credits for downtime beyond the threshold; for the pilot we could accept 99.95 if there are clear rollback/fallback steps

Can you share a ballpark for pilot pricing and whether Redwood can accept a one-year data-retention cap aligned to our security policy? I attached procurement contacts export for your procurement team.

Appreciate keeping this tight — we’d like to decide on pilot commercials by next Tuesday if possible.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Product Operations, CareBridge Health
marta.lopez@carebridge.ai

Hi Marta / Tom — looping in Ben for approvals and adding a short commercial note so procurement has context.

Ballpark pilot pricing (quick, non-binding):
- Pilot (3 months, up to 2k messages/day ingest): $18k/month base + $0.0025/msg after threshold.
- Pilot discount: we can offer a one-time pilot discount; I’m requesting an internal exception for a 10–15% discount depending on ELA intent.

SLA options & approach:
- Redwood standard: 99.9% uptime
- Conditional upgrade: 99.95% for pilot (or 99.99% for full ELA) subject to legal & ops approval; elevated SLA will require an SLA amendment and potential service-credit clauses.

Action items I need from internal team (Ben) to proceed with CareBridge by Tue:
- Ben: provisionally approve up to 15% pilot discount + conditional SLA upgrade to 99.95% for pilot OR advise cap and required legal review items
- Legal: we’ll route SLA-waiver-request + redlines once Ben confirms commercial posture

Marta — if that pricing framework and conditional SLA model sound reasonable, please confirm and I’ll prepare a one-page commercial summary and the exception packet for Ben/Legal. Thanks — we’ll aim to keep the internal review same-day so CareBridge can hit your Tuesday timeline.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks team — reviewed the ask.

Decision (provisional): I approve a pilot commercial posture with a 10% pilot discount and conditional SLA uplift to 99.95% for the pilot period, subject to Legal sign-off on contract language (Service credits capped at 6 months’ fees, standard indemnities remain).

Requests for Legal / Ops
- Legal: please review the attached SLA-waiver-request.pdf and confirm acceptable credit language & termination triggers.
- Ops: confirm we can support 99.95% for the pilot schedule and provide a runbook for rollback/fallback.

Irene / Neha — proceed to prepare the one-page commercial summary and route Legal the SLA waiver packet. Once Legal confirms language, we’ll finalize pilot PO and signatures.
